messages:
mia-newhire: Hey team 44b two quick onboarding benefits/payroll questions from week 1: 1) My offer said benefits start on my first day (2025-04-01) but the carrier confirmation email lists 05/01. Is that normal? 2) I had a dental cleaning on 2025-03-30 (day before start) and paid $92. If carrier backdates to 04/01 can that be claimed? Also worried my first paycheck shows CA withholding but I moved to OR. Who handles retro tax changes?

tess-peopleops: Welcome @mia-newhire! Short answers: (1) Carriers sometimes set effective dates to the 1st of the month after enrollment if enrollment hits a cutoff; we can escalate. Please DM your enrollment timestamp and upload any enrollment confirmation pdf. (2) If the carrier approves a retro effective date you should file a member claim with the carrier attaching the receipt. If they deny, People Ops can process a one-time manual reimbursement (expense code "benefits-one-time") but it may be taxable.

payroll-bot: Automated note: State withholding changes made in Workday after payroll cutoff (T-7 days) will take effect next pay period. To request retroactive withholding corrections submit a delta payroll request: https://payroll.redwood.internal/delta. Include proof of OR residency and the date of move.

ben-hr: @tess I'll check payroll cutoff for Mia's first pay run. @mia-newhire DM your employee ID and upload a utility lease for OR residency. If CA taxes were withheld we can file a correction; timeline is typically 1-2 pay cycles.

benefits-team: Filing ticket BEN-5128 to confirm carrier rules for retroactive medical/dental effective dates. Expect carrier reply in 48-72h. If carrier confirms retro, we will share next steps for claim submission.

mia-newhire: Thanks all 60a sent DM with emp ID and uploaded lease + enrollment pdf. Appreciate the quick responses!
